question: Six players A to F each scored a different value from 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 and 60 in a game. Clues: C scored exactly 20 more than D; F scored 20; B scored exactly 20 more than E; E scored 10. How many did A score?
Seven teams play a league in which every team plays every other team twice (once at home, once away). How many matches are played in all?
Six players A to F play a chess round-robin: each pair plays one game, a win scores 1 point, a draw 0.5 each and a loss 0. Final scores: A 4, B 3.5, C 3, D 2.5, E 1.5. What did F score?
In a group of 100 people, 60 like A, 50 like B and 40 like C. 25 like both A and B, 15 like both B and C, 20 like both A and C, and 10 like all three. How many like exactly two of the three?
A father is 4 times as old as his son. After 6 years he will be 3 times as old as the son. What is the father's present age?
In a test, 30 students of Section A averaged 60 marks and 20 students of Section B averaged 80 marks. What is the average of all 50 students?
A cost-of-living index with base 2019 = 100 reads 130 in 2021 and 156 in 2023. If 2021 is taken as the new base (=100), what is the index for 2023?
The price of cooking oil rises by 25%. By what percentage must a family cut its consumption so that its monthly spending on oil stays the same?

5 runners Tara, Uday, Vikram, Waqar and Yash finish a race with no ties (position 1 is the first to finish). Uday finished between Tara and Yash. Waqar and Yash did not finish in consecutive places. Waqar finished after Tara. Waqar finished between Uday and Yash. Who finished in position 3?

6 tenants Jaya, Kunal, Lata, Manoj, Nisha and Omkar each live on a different floor of a 6-storey building (floor 1 is the lowest). Nisha lives on the floor immediately above Kunal's. Jaya and Omkar do not live on adjacent floors. Lata and Omkar do not live on adjacent floors. Nisha lives on a floor between those of Jaya and Kunal. Nisha and Jaya do not live on adjacent floors. Exactly 4 floors lie between the floors of Lata and Jaya. On which floor does Nisha live?

7 runners Anil, Bhavna, Charu, Dinesh, Eshan, Falguni and Gopal finish a race with no ties (position 1 is the first to finish). Exactly 3 runners finished between Eshan and Bhavna. Falguni finished between Bhavna and Gopal. Falguni finished after Eshan. Bhavna and Falguni did not finish in consecutive places. Gopal and Falguni finished in consecutive places. Falguni finished between Charu and Dinesh. Gopal finished between Charu and Falguni. Which of the following must be true?
A: Anil and Eshan finished in consecutive places

question:
A 3 x 3 table of whole numbers between 1 and 9 (inclusive) has the row totals and column totals shown. Each of the numbers 1 to 9 is used exactly once in the grid. A blank is shown by _.
Row 1: 6, 7, _ (total 21)
Row 2: 5, _, _ (total 10)
Row 3: 9, _, 3 (total 14)
Column totals: 20, 13, 12
What number goes in Row 2, Column 2?
15 identical laddoos are put into four boxes P, Q, R and S. Every box holds at least 1 laddoo and no box holds more than 6. In how many ways can this be done?

In a 6-team single round-robin there are no draws and a win earns 1 point. The top 4 teams qualify, and ties on points are broken by a coin toss that could go either way. What is the smallest number of wins that guarantees a team qualifies?
Machine P packs 15 boxes an hour and Machine Q packs 25 boxes an hour. Working together, how many hours do they need to pack 120 boxes?

Priya can attend a workshop only on days when she is free. She is free every 3rd day starting from day 2 (days 2, 5, 8, ...). Ravi is free every 4th day starting from day 2 (days 2, 6, 10, ...). Counting day 1 as the first day, on which day do they next share a free day after day 2?

Tasks and durations in days: P 4, Q 3, R 5, S 2, T 3, U 2. Precedence: R needs P; S needs P and Q; T needs R; U needs S and T. Unlimited workers are available. By how many days can task S be delayed without delaying the whole project?
A delivery rider moves on a city grid only east or north. To go from the depot to a customer who is 3 blocks east and 2 blocks north, how many different shortest routes are there?
On a city grid a rider moves only east or north from the start (0,0) to the destination (5,3). She must pass through the market at (2,1). How many different shortest routes are there?

Line A trains leave Origin every 12 minutes starting at 6:00 and take 25 minutes to reach Hub. Line B trains leave Hub every 15 minutes starting at 6:05 and take 20 minutes to reach Destination. Walking between the Line A and Line B platforms at Hub takes 5 minutes. Rahul reaches Origin at 7:10 and boards the first Line A train he can. At what time does he reach Destination?
70% of the people in a town drink tea and 60% drink coffee. Everyone drinks at least one of the two. What percentage drink both?

Of 100 people, 60 own a TV, 50 own a fridge and 40 own an AC. 25 own both TV and fridge, 20 own both TV and AC, and 15 own both fridge and AC (these pair counts include people who own all three). 5 people own none of the three. How many own exactly two of the three items?

An income tax has these slabs: nothing on the first ₹3,00,000; 5% on the next ₹3,00,000; 10% on the next ₹3,00,000; and 15% on any income above ₹9,00,000. How much tax is payable on an income of ₹11,00,000?
An electricity board charges ₹3 per unit for the first 100 units, ₹5 per unit for the next 100 units and ₹7 per unit beyond 200 units. A household's bill was ₹1,850. How many units did it use?
